shown.message:
Version 1 (`main` into `release`) is merged, so it is now published. `candidate-2` (PR #9) is waiting on `figtab-repo` to re-check Table 3.

- **Version 1:** this is the paper before the live DSPy check. `internal-review-repo` approved it with two must-fix items for `final`. The real-tool check (C8) is now in the paper and its verdict is reported as computed. The checklist compute figures (311.7 CPU-hours charged to all jobs, including lost work) match the README's. `internal-review-repo` also listed some optional wording and figure comments for `final`. I haven't addressed those yet.
- **PR #9:**
  - `experiment-repo` approved it after checking every number in Section 5.5, the method line and checklist item 8 against its code. It raised one wording point, now fixed. The text said "zero-shot variants", but the 19 programs are 16 demonstration sets plus three baselines (zero-shot, labels only, unshuffled). The standard error of 0.013 on the 0.008 difference is the tool's own, and the text now says so.
  - `figtab-repo` had resized Table 3 and added compute rows to Table 1 on `dev`. I merged both in and added to the Table 3 caption that the tool's interval contains the replay gap.
  - In the local build the main text ends on page 9 with no overfull boxes. I haven't checked the system's `document` branch build for `pull-9`.

Next: merge PR #9 once `figtab-repo` approves, check the `pull-9` build, then open the `final` pull request from `release`.
